geometry_diagnostics.contact_model: ComFree compliant projected soft-finger response with softly penalized hand-object compression
geometry_diagnostics.intrinsic_torque_convention: free contact moment only; excludes moment arm cross contact force

closure_model.contact_model: coupled sliding and torsional friction pyramid
closure_model.torsional_coefficient_units: m; maximum intrinsic normal torque in Nm is coefficient times normal force in N
closure_model.torsional_budget: sliding and intrinsic torsion share the nonnegative-ray normal-force budget
closure_model.equilibrium_state_selection: smallest finite raw wrench residual among semismooth Newton iterates including initial state; force witness always audited
closure_model.force_effort_normalization: mean over contacts of squared normal force / test_force_n squared
closure_model.optimized_variables: one nominal normal preload per fixed template contact
closure_model.scenarios: zero external wrench, then positive and negative six-dimensional axes
closure_model.force_bound: nominal preload only; actual normal force is not bounded by it

geometry_diagnostics.acceptance: Projected friction closure and separate self-penetration limit; hand-object compression softly penalized; coverage diagnostic only; no native physical evaluation
